Supports both Unity 2022.3.62f2 (2022 LTS) and Unity 6 (6000.6.5f1).

## Changes
- Expand the maintained catalog to 181 screen profiles: 89 Apple and 92 Android, including six paired foldables.
- Move the tools into the official DeviceSimulatorPlugin control panel and isolate remaining internal API access.
- Preserve search, filters, favorites, inner/outer switching, clean/framed PNG capture and batch HTML galleries.
- Fix search Enter handling and the floating-window Test Tools menu in Unity 2022.3.
- Add six workflow GIFs, sample gallery and dual-version support information.
- Improve model-matched frames and safe-area evidence; provenance records retain approximation and artwork limitations.

## Install
In Unity Package Manager, install from Git URL:

```text
https://github.com/dghn/editorcraft-device-simulator-tools.git#v0.2.0
```

## Validation
Both Editors passed local integration checks for 181 profiles, 676 orientations and 8 PNG captures per version. UI checks covered search, favorites, paired displays and PNG/HTML export. Static integrity and seven installer tests pass. Other Editor patches require validation; this does not certify physical devices or artwork redistribution rights. The earlier clean Git-install report is historical and does not constitute a clean-install test of this tag.
